name: Inbou Utahime
source:
A famous singer Reimi feels suspects a recently debuted idol Yuuka in having an affair with Reimi's manager. Reimi gives several men an order to rape Yuuka together with her stylist Rikako and make photos of it. Yuuka is easily lured in the apartment with trap set. But in a sudden turn of events soon positions get reversed...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
著名歌手Reimi怀疑最近出道的偶像Yuuka与Reimi的经纪人有染。丽美命令几个男人强奸优花和她的造型师莉香子，并拍照。优香很容易被设置了陷阱的公寓引诱到公寓里。但事态突然发生转变，很快立场就发生了逆转……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
